messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-serving-prod" severity=P1 — Incident 476182. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/476182
PagerDuty: Auto-escalation: primary oncall did not acknowledge within 2m. Paging secondary: @Anjali.
Morgan: acking here, reading details. seeing 5xx spike on 4 hosts, flows failing at tokenize step.
Anjali: ack — stepping in. can someone post recent deploys?
Devon: no deploys in last 45m, autocanary reports ok. root logs show connection errors to redis-kv-cache-1.
SRE-Lead: switching to incident runbook: runbook.infra/retry-cache-failures. @Morgan start collecting tail of worker logs and kv cache latency graphs.
Morgan: collecting logs, hitting tail: ```
2026-03-15T03:12:42Z ERROR handler.go:117 request_id=abc123 tokenization failed: rpc error: code=Unavailable desc="connection refused"
2026-03-15T03:12:43Z WARN cache.go:88 miss, falling back to cold path
```
Anjali: verified increased 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 12% over 3m. affected route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-large-1).
Devon: temporary mitigation idea: flip clients to model-variant redwood-large-1-ephemeral which uses a different cache tier. Would reduce capacity but keep latency. Thoughts?
SRE-Lead: Good suggestion. Do it as a canary: 20% traffic reroute first. @PagerDuty could we mark mitigation step in incident?
PagerDuty: Note logged: "20% traffic reroute to variant redwood-large-1-ephemeral". Also escalated to manager after 5m unack by secondary: paging SRE Manager @Morgan.
Morgan: :grimacing: I'm already in. initiating rollout command now: ```
# route 20% to ephemeral
infractl traffic split set --service inference-serving-prod --variant redwood-large-1-ephemeral --percent 20
```
IncidentBot: action recorded: traffic split change executed by Morgan.
Anjali: monitoring metrics — 5xx dropping to 6% in last 2m, p99 latency up 80ms but overall throughput stable.
Devon: still seeing a subset of requests hitting kv timeouts from region eu-west-1. Is the cache tier degraded?
SRE-Lead: oncall to open a follow-up with infra team for redis cluster. @Anjali please open a pagerduty incident for infra team or link existing.
Anjali: opened PD/infra-7892 and added crosslink. infra-team notified.
Morgan: temporary customer impact message drafted for status page: "We are investigating elevated errors for inference requests affecting a subset of customers in EU. Traffic has been partially rerouted; mitigations in progress." ready to post after SRE-Lead review.
SRE-Lead: post it. also create a short bridge in 10 minutes to coordinate if infra needs to failover. I'll join.
PagerDuty: Escalation note: primary unack -> secondary ack -> manager paged at 03:17:20Z. Incident reminders set every 10m.
IncidentBot: Reminder: please update incident with any mitigation steps.
Anjali: infra confirmed master redis node in eu-west-1 has intermittent IO stall; they're failing over. ETA ~4-6m.
Devon: after failover, can we revert the 20% traffic split back? plan is to monitor 2 consecutive 5m windows.
Morgan: agree. if failover succeeds and 5xx < 0.5% we start gradual rollback.
SRE-Lead: update timeline in incident notes and tag customer-impact={"affecting_eu_customers": "true", "estimated_pct_requests": "8%"}. (Note: tagging done in PD).
PagerDuty: Incident 476182: manager acknowledged at 03:19:05Z.
IncidentBot: Bridge created by SRE-Lead: https://meet.example/bridge/476182.
Anjali: failover completed at 03:22:11Z. redis master role moved. observing error rate dropping to 1.1% over last minute.
Morgan: rolling back traffic split to 0% ephemeral: ```
infractl traffic split set --service inference-serving-prod --variant redwood-large-1-ephemeral --percent 0
```
IncidentBot: action recorded: traffic split rollback executed by Morgan.
Devon: p95/p99 latencies a bit elevated as KV warms but errors are back to baseline 0.3%.
SRE-Lead: good work. we will keep incident open for 30m post-restoral for monitoring. please add a short blameless postmortem note once we close.
Morgan: posting to status page now. I'll also update the incident summary with timeline and mitigation commands.
Anjali: closing infra PD after confirm.
PagerDuty: Incident 476182 resolved at 03:45:05Z (root cause: redis master IO stall; mitigation: redis failover and temporary traffic reroute).
Morgan: :white_check_mark: Thanks team — will follow up with RCA draft.
SRE-Lead: assigning RCA owner @Devon. please capture why IO stall occurred and whether we need additional alerting for cache IO latency.
Devon: got it, will start RCA and share draft in #postmortems in 24h.
